how_to_apply: Apply online through the IIT Delhi jobs page, home.iitd.ac.in/jobs-iitd/index.php.
Upload a detailed Academic Profile, as listed under Documents Required.
Upload all educational qualification certificates, including the date of Ph.D. Defense, and the category certificate if applicable.
Fill a separate online application for each academic unit. Candidates with overlapping interests may be considered for joint appointment.
Submit the completed application with supporting documents on or before 31 December 2026, 23:59 PM (IST), and retain a copy.
Check the application status at ecampus.iitd.ac.in/IITDFR-0/login.

Candidates in Government, Semi-Government, Public Undertakings, universities or educational institutions must apply with their employer's consent. They may send an advance copy through the portal, informing the Dean (Faculty), or submit a No Objection Certificate at the interview.

The phone number is +91-11-2654-8733 and the email is [email protected]. For technical help, write to [email protected] or [email protected].

Outstation candidates called for a personal interview are reimbursed to-and-fro 2-Tier AC railway fare or economy class airfare by the shortest route within India. Candidates coming from abroad are reimbursed up to Rs.40,000/- or the actual fare, whichever is less. Air tickets should be booked through M/S Balmer Lawrie & Co. Ltd, M/S Ashoka Travels and Tours or M/S Indian Railways Catering and Tourism Corporation Ltd.
important_instructions: Chemical Engineering: candidates who already applied in the previous two consecutive cycles need not apply. TRIP: candidates who appeared for Stage II interaction will not be considered for shortlisting until one year after that interaction. Women candidates are especially encouraged to apply. If any information in the application is found incorrect, the appointment is liable to be cancelled or terminated. For more information, candidates can contact the Head of the concerned academic unit.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi does not print the number of posts. It lists the academic units below as recruiting Associate Professor and Professor. In Annexure-I, two units are marked "Not Hiring" for the Professor post. Reservation applies under the CEI (RTC) Act (2019) for SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS and the RPwD Act (2016) for persons with benchmark disabilities. The extent of reservation is SC-15%, ST-7.5%, OBC(NCL)-27%, EWS-10% and PwBD-4%. Biochemical Engineering & Biotechnology: Biochemical Engineering, Metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, enzyme and bioprocess technology, Downstream processing. Chemical Engineering: Energy & Environment; Novel Materials & Reactor Engineering; Healthcare & Biomanufacturing; Multiscale Simulation & Data Analytics. Civil & Environmental Engineering: Construction Engineering and Management; Structural Engineering; Transportation Engineering; Water Resources Engineering (Hydraulics and Remote sensing). Computer Science & Engineering: Systems; Computer Vision and Computer Graphics; Quantum computing; Security, Privacy and Reliability; Artificial intelligence, Machine learning, Robotics and Human Interfaces. Design: Industrial Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design. Electrical Engineering: Integrated Electronics, Circuits and Devices; Communication Engineering; Power Systems; Power Electronics and Electrical Machines; Computing and Intelligent Systems; Systems, Learning and Control. Exceptionally skilled candidates in other areas may also be considered on a case-by-case basis. Humanities and Social Sciences (Economics): Quantitative Macroeconomics; Econometrics; Game Theory and Decision Sciences; Public Economics / Urban Economics / Energy–Environment / International Trade. Management Studies: Information Systems, including Cyber security, AR/VR, Metaverse, Generative Artificial Intelligence, Digital platforms, Digital transformation, Design Sciences and Human Computer Interaction. Physics: Optics/Photonics Cluster; High Energy Physics, Astronomy and Astrophysics; Complex Systems Theory and Experimental Biophysics; Plasma Physics; Condensed matter physics (Semiconductor device). Textile & Fibre Engineering: Fibre science and technology, polymer processing and characterization, high performance and functional fibres, and staple fibre-to-yarn engineering and yarn testing. content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: For both posts, the qualifying experience must be in IITs or similar institutes of national importance, or at an equivalent level in any other Indian or foreign institution of comparable standards. Both posts also require the following: specialization in the appropriate area/branch, with a consistently good academic record throughout; good communication skills; a commitment to high quality undergraduate and postgraduate education; a demonstrated ability to carry out original and creative research. The shortlisting criteria below are required as on the last date of application. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post in each academic unit, candidates should check Annexure-I and Annexure-III of the official notification. Only persons with not less than 40% of relevant disability, certified by the Competent Medical Board, are eligible for reservation. The PwBD reservation is at institute level. No separate unit-wise roster is prepared. Eligible categories are Blind/Low Vision, Deaf/Hard of Hearing, and locomotor categories (OA, BA, OL, BL, OAL, LC, Dwarfism, Acid Attack Victims). ASD (Mild), SLD, Mental Illness and Multiple Disabilities involving these are also eligible. The selection committee may take the final call on the PwBD candidate's ability to undertake research and teaching assignments.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Both posts carry Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Transport Allowance and telephone charges reimbursement as per Institute rules. These at present correspond to those admissible to Central Government employees stationed in Delhi. LTC, Children Education Allowance and contribution towards the New Pension Scheme (NPS) are permissible as per GoI rules. The Selection Committee may offer a higher starting salary in deserving cases, depending on qualifications and experience. Relocation from abroad: one-way economy airfare for the recruit and immediate family, plus relocation allowance of up to ₹2,50,000/- or actual, whichever is less. This is subject to serving the Institute for at least 3 years. Relocation within India: one-way economy airfare, plus relocation allowance of up to ₹1,25,000/- or actual, whichever is less. The same 3-year condition applies. Professional Development Allowance: ₹ 3 lakhs for every block period of 3 years, paid on a reimbursable basis for conferences, professional memberships and contingent expenses. Chair Professor positions: a grant of ₹ 5 lakhs per annum for an initial 3 years, extendable up to 5 years. Accommodation: new faculty may first stay in transit accommodation. Leased accommodation outside the campus is supported with monthly rental of up to ₹ 60,500/- until campus accommodation is provided. Other support: medical insurance for cashless in-patient treatment and free outpatient support at the Institute Hospital, flexible sabbatical leave, and professional visits during vacation. Foreign nationals: appointed on contract basis, initially for 5 years, and the contract can be renewed. Half-time appointments are possible for those not on OCI status. A work visa from the Government of India is needed.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Annexure-II gives one description of the nature of work for Professor, Associate Professor and other academic positions: Teach UG/PG students in Science/Engineering/Humanities and Social Science/Management/Policy and Design. Conduct research and guide research work. Deliver lectures, and conduct seminars and workshops. Set examination papers and evaluate answer books. Maintain class registers and records. The work is performed mostly inside, in well-lighted places.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 31 December 2026, 23:59 PM (IST), under Rolling Advertisement No. IITD/2026/PROF-2.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts are offered in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Associate Professor and Professor posts are offered in 19 academic units. The Biochemical Engineering & Biotechnology and Humanities and Social Sciences departments are marked "Not Hiring" for Professor.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for IIT Delhi Associate Professor and Professor posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need a Ph.D., with first class or equivalent in the preceding degree, and a consistently good academic record. Academic units add their own criteria in Annexure-I.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Associate Professor needs at least 6 years, with 3 at Assistant Professor level or equivalent. Professor needs at least 10 years, with 4 at Associate Professor level or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIT Delhi Associate Professor and Professor?
faq.answer: Associate Professor: ₹ 1,39,600 – 2,11,300/- in Academic Pay Level 13A2. Professor: ₹ 1,59,100 – 2,20,200/- in Academic Pay Level 14A. DA, HRA and TA are paid as per Institute rules.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for IIT Delhi faculty posts?
faq.answer: Apply online at home.iitd.ac.in/jobs-iitd/index.php and upload the Academic Profile and certificates by 31 December 2026. Retain a copy of the submitted application.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification, experience, research, publication records and the academic unit's requirements. Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply to more than one department?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate online application must be filled for each academic unit, and candidates with overlapping interests may be considered for joint appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Are foreign nationals appointed on a regular basis?
faq.answer: No. Foreign nationals are appointed on contract basis, initially for 5 years, and the contract can be renewed after that tenure. A Government of India work visa is needed.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel fare paid for the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. Outstation candidates get 2-Tier AC railway or economy airfare within India. Candidates coming from abroad get up to Rs.40,000/- or the actual fare, whichever is less.
